title: Decentralized Data Discovery Network
definition: A network that enables decentralized publication and discovery of data, built on the AT Protocol.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A system that allows anyone to publish lightweight records pointing to their data, making it discoverable in a decentralized manner, similar to a library catalog.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A network utilizing the AT Protocol for decentralized data publication and discovery, consisting of lightweight records linking to datasets with optional tags.
difficulty_levels.expert: A data network based on AT Protocol, empowering users to publish records that link to their datasets, fostering a decentralized card catalog for data, primarily dominated by geospatial/satellite imagery publishers but open to non-geo contributions.

extra_fields.insight: Decentralizing data discovery, enabling anyone to publish lightweight records that point to datasets, fostering a decentralized card catalog for data.
